name: Tampa Airport Marriott
notes: In-terminal. Guests walk to their flights so no airport runs - but heavy dinner/downtown/Ybor demand and misconnect walk-ups late.

name: Tampa Marriott Westshore
notes: No shuttle plus corporate base equals reliable morning airport runs. Anchor of the Westshore cluster.

name: Hilton Tampa Airport Westshore
notes: Shuttle does not run early or late - those are exactly your windows.

name: Grand Hyatt Tampa Bay
notes: Large resort/conference property on the bay. Shuttle kills airport runs but dinner and event outflow is strong.

name: Renaissance Tampa International Plaza
notes: Attached to International Plaza mall. No shuttle. Shoppers and diners on top of hotel guests.

name: DoubleTree by Hilton Tampa Airport Westshore
notes: Largest room count in the cluster. Volume alone produces spillover when the shuttle is full or off-hours.

name: Embassy Suites by Hilton Tampa Airport Westshore
notes: All-suite, longer stays. Shuttle-served so lean on evening dining runs.

name: The Westin Tampa Bay
notes: On the causeway. Somewhat stranded - guests rideshare for anything off-property.

name: Crowne Plaza Tampa Westshore
notes: No shuttle. Southern edge of Westshore, good bridge toward Hyde Park demand.

name: Four Points by Sheraton Suites Tampa Airport Westshore
notes: Off-hours only - shuttle covers the middle of the day.

name: Hampton Inn Tampa International Airport/Westshore
notes: Closest of the select-service properties. Shuttle-served.

name: Courtyard Tampa Westshore/Airport
notes: No shuttle - punches above its size for morning airport runs.

name: Residence Inn Tampa Airport Westshore
notes: Extended stay. Grocery and dinner runs midweek evenings.

name: Ramada by Wyndham Tampa Airport Westshore
notes: Budget tier - riders more price-sensitive, surge captures are thinner.

name: TownePlace Suites Tampa Westshore/Airport
notes: Small extended-stay. Fill-in only.

name: La Quinta Inn & Suites Tampa Airport Stadium Westshore
notes: Best on Raymond James Stadium event days rather than as a standing spot.

name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Tampa Airport Westshore
notes: Northern edge. Weaker than the core Westshore block.

name: Holiday Inn Express Tampa Stadium/Airport
notes: Pairs with the stadium calendar.

name: Comfort Inn & Suites St. Pete-Clearwater International Airport
notes: Allegiant red-eye schedule means very early and very late runs when the shuttle is dark. Best PIE spot.

name: SpringHill Suites St. Petersburg Clearwater
notes: No shuttle and closest to the field. Pairs with pie-01 on the same corridor.

name: Hilton St. Petersburg Carillon Park
notes: Corporate Carillon office park. Weekday business travel, no shuttle. Strongest non-leisure demand near PIE.

name: Holiday Inn St. Petersburg N - Clearwater
notes: Off-hours only around the shuttle.

name: Hampton Inn & Suites Clearwater/St. Petersburg-Ulmerton Rd
notes: Same Ulmerton cluster. Address approximate - navigate by name.

name: Home2 Suites by Hilton Clearwater St. Petersburg Ulmerton Rd
notes: Extended stay, no shuttle. Address unverified - navigate by name.

name: Courtyard St. Petersburg Clearwater
notes: Business-leaning. Address approximate.

name: Residence Inn St. Petersburg Clearwater
notes: Eastern end of the corridor, further from the field.

name: Hyatt Place Sarasota/Bradenton Airport
notes: Directly across University Pkwy from the terminal. Closest reliable stage point at SRQ.

name: Courtyard Sarasota Bradenton Airport
notes: Across from the terminal, no shuttle. See notes - strong morning spot.

name: Hampton Inn & Suites Sarasota/Bradenton Airport
notes: Shuttle-served, so work the shoulders.

name: Homewood Suites by Hilton Sarasota/Airport
notes: Extended stay on the Tamiami corridor. Address approximate.

name: Embassy Suites by Hilton Sarasota
notes: Downtown/bayfront edge of the 3 mi ring. Dinner and Van Wezel event outflow is excellent.

name: The Ritz-Carlton Sarasota
notes: Just outside 3 mi but included deliberately - highest fare-per-trip in the SRQ zone. Evening only.

name: Art Ovation Hotel Autograph Collection
notes: Downtown arts district. Tracks the theater and gallery calendar.

name: Hotel Indigo Sarasota
notes: Small but well placed for downtown dinner runs.

name: Fairfield Inn & Suites Sarasota Bradenton
notes: Budget-leaning. Fill-in spot. Address approximate.

name: Hyatt Place Fort Myers/Airport
notes: Closest hotel to RSW. Work the shuttle shoulders - RSW banks start very early in season.

name: Hilton Garden Inn Fort Myers Airport/FGCU
notes: FGCU and corporate park traffic on top of airport guests.

name: Four Points by Sheraton Fort Myers Airport
notes: Same Chamberlin cluster. Address approximate - navigate by name.

name: Home2 Suites by Hilton Fort Myers Airport
notes: No shuttle. Address approximate.

name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Fort Myers Airport
notes: Daniels corridor - outside 3 mi, listed because the true 3 mi ring at RSW is nearly empty.

name: SpringHill Suites Fort Myers Airport
notes: Daniels corridor. Address approximate.

name: Comfort Inn & Suites Fort Myers Airport
notes: Shuttle runs 05:00-22:00 only - the gaps are the opportunity.

name: Hampton Inn & Suites Fort Myers Airport
notes: Address approximate - navigate by name.

name: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Punta Gorda
notes: Closest to PGD. Only worth staging around published departure banks - otherwise dead.

name: Fairfield Inn & Suites Punta Gorda
notes: Same Jones Loop cluster as pgd-01.

name: Four Points by Sheraton Punta Gorda Harborside
notes: Downtown harborside - outside 3 mi. Dinner runs, not airport runs.

name: The Wyvern Hotel
notes: Small boutique. Rooftop bar produces late evening trips.

name: Baymont by Wyndham Punta Gorda/Port Charlotte
notes: Budget tier. Thin captures.

name: Hilton Naples
notes: Best standing spot in the Naples zone. Full-service, no shuttle, restaurant-heavy corridor.

name: Inn on Fifth
notes: Heart of 5th Avenue South dining. The single most reliable evening surge address in Naples.

name: Hyatt House Naples/5th Avenue
notes: On 5th Ave S with a marina. Strong dinner and beach-run demand.

name: AC Hotel by Marriott Naples 5th Avenue
notes: Newer build on the 5th Ave corridor. Younger guest mix means higher rideshare uptake.

name: Holiday Inn Express Naples Downtown - 5th Avenue
notes: Closest cluster to APF itself. Solid but lower fare-per-trip than the boutiques.

name: La Quinta Inn & Suites by Wyndham Naples Downtown
notes: Confirmed 1.3 mi from APF. Budget tier - volume over fare size.

name: Naples Grande Beach Resort
notes: Just outside 3 mi but by far the largest room count in the zone. Worth the deadhead in season.

name: Bellasera Resort
notes: All-suite resort a block off 5th Ave S.

name: Cove Inn on Naples Bay
notes: Bayfront, quieter. Situational.

name: Trianon Old Naples
notes: Small property. Only worth it while already staged on 5th Ave.

name: Courtyard Naples
notes: Mid-corridor between APF and the Hilton. Reasonable bridge spot.
